content.rendered:
Kindergarten Open House is an event for parents and incoming Kindergarten students to visit the school, hear from staff members, and meet their peers.

Kindergarten Open House will be held March 7th, 4:00-6:00 pm at Hawks View Elementary.

Families should park in the parking lot and enter the building through the Activity Entrance. Sessions will start every 20 minutes, beginning at 4:20, with the last session at 5:40.

While waiting for sessions to begin, families will be given a chance to meet representatives from the Parent Advisory Committee (PAC), learn about the on-site after school care option, take a picture in the self-serve photo area, and see a few parts of our school building.

Please find our Kindergarten special Edition Newsletter HERE.
